reasons.correctness: Every interface name and signature matches the task. PLN returns 1, ISO codes match case-insensitively, rounding is 2 decimals HALF_UP, and a missing rate throws BusinessRuleTranslatableException with the key and ISO code. Hidden acceptance tests passed 5/5, build green.
reasons.convention_fit: Port sits in currency/port and the adapter in currency/adapter. CurrencyConversionService depends on ExchangeRatePort only. Injection is by explicit constructors. The new key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. Exemplars were read before writing (GusBir1RegistryAdapter, FakturowniaConfig).
reasons.design_fit: Small footprint: FixedExchangeRateConfig enables the properties the same way FakturowniaConfig does, and the service keeps only the arithmetic. Keys are upper-cased once in setRates, and the lookup side normalizes the input. No existing currency class is duplicated or modified.
reasons.test_quality: Three MockitoExtension unit tests, no Spring context. They cover conversion, the HALF_UP boundary (3.995×2), pass-through of the ISO code, the missing-rate key and args, case-insensitivity, PLN=1, unknown and null codes, and key normalization. 11/11 pass.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries ran before any read: one found ports, adapters and properties classes, one found the currency package, one found TESTED_BY links. A dependents query on CurrencyService and CurrencyConverter ran before writing. The chosen exemplars (registry port/adapter, Fakturownia config) shaped the new files.
